body.statement: For \(d\geq4\), determine whether every nonconstant homogeneous exactly self-normalizing \(D_d\in\mathbb R[Sd]\) admits one common complete invariant flag for its relative gradients, or construct the least-dimensional polynomial counterexample with varying spectral data and certify that no recursive flag represents it.
body.justification: Dimension three is the last setting where the first spectral power sums discretize the spectrum, so higher dimensions require a new invariant-flag mechanism.
body.gap: Tamano's all-dimensional converse assumes a common invariant flag, while Tunçel--Vandenberghe derive recursive flags from homogeneous-cone automorphisms rather than from self-normalization.
body.consumer: A resolution would delimit complete denominator auditing for rational causal certificates using more than three covariance directions.
